Resolves #21391

Enter on a lane's collapse toggle no longer opens the focused card's editor. `SelectionModel#onKeyDownEnter()` skipped a column's collapse button and a card's menu button by class; one rule replaces both: when the key event's path holds a `<button>`, Enter belongs to that button and the board activates no card. That covers the lane toggle the class list missed, and any button a later header adds.

Evidence: L3 (unit case red on `dev` and green at head; the swimlanes e2e in Chromium with this fix) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside CI until #21357 lands: `SwimlanesNL.spec.mjs` from `ada/21357-board-swimlanes` (`d185884fd5`) on this head passes 16 of 16 over two repeats, including "a row collapses and expands by click, and by Enter and Space on its toggle, and keeps its header and count". Without this fix that case fails: after Enter the editor holds the focus, and Space never reaches the toggle |
| AC-2 | CI: `test/playwright/unit/board/SelectionModel.spec.mjs` › "Enter on a button in the board belongs to the button: a lane or column toggle or a card menu activates no card" (Enter on the focused card still activates it), and the existing "Enter and double-click fire cardActivate for the focused card only …" |
| AC-3 | CI: the same new case. On `dev`'s `SelectionModel.mjs` it fails at `neo-board-lane-collapse`: the call returns the `CardEditor` |

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket's Architectural Reality said path nodes carry `tag`. They carry `tagName`, lower case (`src/main/DomEvents.mjs`, `getTargetData()`), so the rule reads `node.tagName === 'button'`, and the ticket body is corrected. The same mismatch leaves `isEditableTarget()`'s `tag === 'input'` and `tag === 'textarea'` checks unable to match a browser path; out of scope, noted in a defect-note.

## Test Evidence

The board's unit specs pass 169 of 169 at this head. The swimlanes run above is the browser witness; it moves into CI with #21357.
